Prototype II / Digital translation

Architecture of Memories

This experimental archive translates a physical collection of layered tracing-paper maps into a digital reading experience. Two childhood homes are reconstructed from interviews, architectural references, and annotations recorded during follow-up conversations.

Blue traces recollections. Red marks uncertainty. Green identifies corrections and discoveries. The maps preserve differences between remembered and documented space rather than making every remembered detail architecturally exact.

This is an interactive mockup using the original uploaded drawings. It is not an exact architectural survey.
